comment: Overall impression: From a Philippine perspective, it would benefit from explicitly recognizing countries with decentralized governance and varying digital maturity across local government units, since implementation and stewardship responsibilities are shared between national and local levels. It would also be useful to emphasize offline and low-bandwidth operation, given connectivity gaps in many areas.
